Package com.example.lotterize.ui.admin

Class AdminProfileFragment

Fragment
com.example.lotterize.ui.admin.AdminProfileFragment
public class AdminProfileFragment extends Fragment
Fragment that displays a list of all user profiles to the admin. Allows searching for users and deleting user accounts with cascade deletion.
